reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. I told her I can't confirm that Oriel Brevik is the main contact for the Linden rollout at Marrow Fieldworks.

I checked only what she can see: #north-team and the shared files. Neither mentions Marrow Fieldworks, a Linden rollout or Oriel Brevik. The North team cheat sheet lists contacts for three other accounts only: Quarrendon, Tamsin and Brackenwater.

I said I'd treat the name as an unconfirmed lead, not a known contact, and suggested adding it to the account notes once the account owner confirms it. I didn't search other channels or message anyone else.
